# e-Mate AI

> e-Mate AI is an all-in-one AI study workspace that turns textbooks, lecture slides, and notes into interactive learning workflows.

## About

e-Mate AI helps students learn more effectively with AI-powered flashcards, practice quizzes, active recall workflows, visual notes, notebooks, and coding tools.

## Features

- Upload study materials and turn them into flashcards, quizzes, and study workflows.
- Use AI models for explanations, research, and everyday study support.
- Work with notebooks, Canvas, and interactive programming workflows.
- Keep study data private and secure.
- Use BYOK (bring your own key) support where available.

## Plans

- **e-Mate AI Plus:** Higher study limits, visual note generation, Flash Thinking, and 100GB notebook storage.
- **e-Mate AI Pro:** Advanced model access, higher limits, Canvas, and notebook study tools.
- **e-Mate AI Ultra:** Higher capacity, priority execution, dedicated compute infrastructure, and shared team workspaces.
